source: Larsen & Toubro Ltd - Screener.in consolidated FY2024-25 (verified against annual report)

balance_sheet._description: IndAS Schedule III format. For banks, borrowings=null (deposits in other_liabilities).
balance_sheet.equity_capital_note: Paid-up share capital (face value × shares outstanding). Includes equity + preference shares.
balance_sheet.reserves_note: Securities premium + general reserve + retained earnings + revaluation surplus + OCI reserves.
balance_sheet.borrowings_note: Long-term borrowings (debentures, term loans, bonds, ECBs) + short-term borrowings (working capital, CP, current maturities). NULL for banks.
balance_sheet.other_liabilities_note: Trade payables + provisions (employee benefits, warranties) + deferred tax + current tax + advances from customers. For banks: includes customer deposits.
balance_sheet.fixed_assets_note: PP&E net of depreciation (land, buildings, plant, machinery, vehicles, furniture) + intangible assets (software, patents, goodwill) + right-of-use assets (IndAS 116).
balance_sheet.cwip_note: Capital work in progress — assets under construction not yet ready for use. Should eventually transfer to fixed_assets.
balance_sheet.investments_note: Investments in subsidiaries/associates/JVs + quoted/unquoted equity & debt + mutual funds + government securities + FDs > 12 months. Banks: large portion (SLR/treasury).
balance_sheet.other_assets_note: Inventory (raw material, WIP, finished goods) + trade receivables + cash & bank balances + loans & advances + prepaid expenses + tax assets (MAT credit, advance tax).

cash_flow._description: IndAS 7 format. Three main activities with key sub-components.
cash_flow.cash_from_operating_note: Indirect method: Net Profit + depreciation ± working capital changes (inventory, receivables, payables) - income tax paid ± other non-cash adjustments.
cash_flow.cash_from_investing_note: Purchase/sale of PP&E (capex) + purchase/sale of investments + acquisition/disposal of subsidiaries + loans given/recovered + interest/dividends received.
cash_flow.cash_from_financing_note: Proceeds/repayment of long-term & short-term borrowings + issue/buyback of equity + dividends paid + interest paid + lease payments (IndAS 116).
cash_flow.net_cash_flow_note: = OCF + ICF + FCF. Should approximate change in cash & bank balances (within other_assets).

prior_year_balance_sheet._description: Previous year (Mar 2024) BS for delta calculations used in cash flow cross-validation.
